entities.name: Agadeem
entities.description: Largest of Ondu's three islands on Zendikar, littered with hedrons.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: Land off whose coast Agadeem lies.

entities.name: Kabira
entities.description: Plateau once hunting grounds for the kor, ruined by Ulamog's brood.

entities.name: Crypt of Agadeem
entities.description: Vast burial complex beneath the island from the Eldrazi era.

entities.name: Cryptlock
entities.description: Stone sculpture barring the trapped tunnels.

entities.name: Witch Vessels
entities.description: Mad mages who bypass the lock and commune with the dead.

entities.name: Vivias
entities.description: Witch Vessel who released the ghosts from the crypt.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose brood destroyed Kabira.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient alien beings who rose on Zendikar.

events.summary: Nissa, Sorin and Anowon are ambushed by an Eldrazi brood on Agadeem and forced to fight before continuing to Beyeen.
events.quote: they were ambushed by a brood of Eldrazi and forced to fight

events.summary: During the Rise of the Eldrazi, Ulamog devastates Kabira.
Witch Vessel Vivias releases the sealed ghosts to torment the living.
events.quote: the Witch Vessel Vivias released the ghosts sealed within the crypt
